texts.text: בָּרְכוּ אֶת־יְיָ הַמְבֹרָךְ:
בָּרוּךְ יְיָ הַמְבֹרָךְ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד:

יִתְבָּרַךְ וְיִשְׁתַּבַּח וְיִתְפָּאַר וְיִתְרוֹמַם וְיִתְנַשֵּׂא שְׁמוֹ שֶׁל מֶלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּלָכִים הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא שֶׁהוּא רִאשׁוֹן וְהוּא אַחֲרוֹן וּמִבַּלְעָדָיו אֵין אֱלֹהִים סֹלּוּ לָרֹכֵב בָּעֲרָבוֹת בְּיָהּ שְׁמוֹ וְעִלְזוּ לְפָנָיו. וּשְׁמוֹ מְרוֹמָם עַל־כָּל־בְּרָכָה וּתְהִלָּה:
בָּרוּךְ שֵׁם כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתוֹ לְעֹלָם וָעֶד:
יְהִי שֵׁם יְיָ מְבֹרָךְ מֵעַתָּה וְעַד עוֹלָם:

בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם אֲשֶׁר בִּדְבָרוֹ מַעֲרִיב עֲרָבִים בְּחָכְמָה פֹּתֵחַ שְׁעָרִים וּבִתְבוּנָה מְשַׁנֶּה עִתִּים וּמַחֲלִיף אֶת־הַזְּמַנִּים וּמְסַדֵּר אֶת־הַכֹּכָבִים בְּמִשְׁמְרוֹתֵיהֶם בָּרָקִיעַ כִּרְצוֹנוֹ בּוֹרֵא יוֹם וָלָיְלָה גּוֹלֵל אוֹר מִפְּנֵי־חֹשֶׁךְ וְחֹשֶׁךְ מִפְּנֵי־אוֹר. וּמַעֲבִיר יוֹם וּמֵבִיא לָיְלָה וּמַבְדִּיל בֵּין יוֹם וּבֵין לָיְלָה יְיָ צְבָאוֹת שְׁמוֹ. אֵל חַי וְקַיָּם תָּמִיד יִמְלוֹךְ עָלֵינוּ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ הַמַּעֲרִיב עֲרָבִים:
texts.position: starts in right column, then runs full width from הַזְּמַנִּים

texts.text: אַהֲבַת עוֹלָם בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמְּךָ אָהָבְתָּ, תּוֹרָה וּמִצְוֹת חֻקִּים וּמִשְׁפָּטִים אוֹתָנוּ לִמַּדְתָּ, עַל־כֵּן יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּשָׁכְבֵנוּ וּבְקוּמֵנוּ נָשִׂיחַ בְּחֻקֶּיךָ, וְנִשְׂמַח בְּדִבְרֵי תוֹרָתֶךָ וּבְמִצְוֹתֶיךָ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד, כִּי הֵם חַיֵּינוּ וְאֹרֶךְ יָמֵינוּ וּבָהֶם נֶהְגֶּה יוֹמָם וָלָיְלָה. וְאַהֲבָתְךָ אַל־תָּסִיר מִמֶּנּוּ לְעוֹלָמִים. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אוֹהֵב עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל:
אֵל מֶלֶךְ נֶאֱמָן:
שְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ יְהוָה ׀ אֶחָד:
texts.position: large type; enlarged ע and ד

texts.text: בָּרוּךְ שֵׁם כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתוֹ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד:
וְאָהַבְתָּ אֵת יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּכָל־לְבָבְךָ וּבְכָל־נַפְשְׁךָ וּבְכָל־מְאֹדֶךָ: וְהָיוּ הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם עַל־
texts.position: full width, bottom; continues on s20 (לְבָבֶךָ)

uncertainties: פֹּתֵחַ: I read no vav (holam on פ), but it is small and could be פּוֹתֵחַ.
הַכֹּכָבִים read as defective spelling, with holam on the first כ and no vav.
Small marks between lines near יְיָ צְבָאוֹת (they look like 'דן') and above בָּרְכוּ (they look like 'ד'). These may be printer's marks or show-through. Not transcribed as text.

In the Shema verses, cantillation (teamim) marks appear and only the vowels were transcribed. The Divine Name in the Shema verses is printed יְהוָה (it may carry an extra holam), as opposed to יְיָ in the blessings.
Commas after אָהָבְתָּ, לִמַּדְתָּ, בְּחֻקֶּיךָ and וָעֶד in Ahavat Olam: they look like commas but could be specks.
The left-column line reads לְעֹלָם (defective), against לְעוֹלָם in the body. The image is low-resolution here.

headings: Evening Prayer for the New Year

instructions.position: italic label, top of left column
italic label, left column before 'Blessed is the Lord'
italic label, top of right column

texts.text: ברכו Bless the Lord, who is called blessed.
Blessed is the Lord who is called blessed for ever and ever.

Blessed art Thou, O Lord our God, King of the World, who by His word brings on the evening, opens the gates in wisdom, changes the times with understanding, alters the periods and orders the stars in their watches in the sky according to His will. He creates day and night, causes light to give way to darkness and darkness to light, leads away the day and brings on the night and distinguishes between day and night. The Lord of Hosts is His Name. The living and eternal God will constantly reign over us for ever and ever. Blessed art Thou, O Lord, who brings on evenings.
texts.position: left column, then full width from 'the periods'

texts.text: Blessed and praised, glorified, exalted and extolled be the Name of the Supreme King of Kings, the Holy One blessed be He. He is the first and He is the last and beside Him there is no God. Make way before Him, who is enthroned above the clouds, Yah is his Name and rejoice before Him, His Name is exalted above all blessing and fame. Blessed be His glorious royal Name for ever and ever.

אהבת With eternal love dost Thou love Thy people, the House of Israel. Torah, commandments, statutes and judgments hast Thou taught us. Therefore, O Lord our God, when we lie down and when we arise, we will speak of Thy statutes. We rejoice in the words of Thy Torah and in Thy commandments for ever and ever, for they are our life and the length of our days and on them will we meditate day and night. Let not Thy love depart from us for all eternity. Blessed art Thou, O Lord, who loves His people Israel.
Hear, O Israel, the Lord is our God, the Lord is One.
Blessed be His glorious royal Name for ever and ever.

texts.text: לְבָבֶךָ: וְשִׁנַּנְתָּם לְבָנֶיךָ וְדִבַּרְתָּ בָּם בְּשִׁבְתְּךָ בְּבֵיתֶךָ וּבְלֶכְתְּךָ בַדֶּרֶךְ וּבְשָׁכְבְּךָ וּבְקוּמֶךָ: וּקְשַׁרְתָּם לְאוֹת עַל־יָדֶךָ וְהָיוּ לְטֹטָפֹת בֵּין עֵינֶיךָ: וּכְתַבְתָּם עַל־מְזֻזוֹת בֵּיתֶךָ וּבִשְׁעָרֶיךָ:

וְהָיָה אִם־שָׁמֹעַ תִּשְׁמְעוּ אֶל־מִצְוֹתַי אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוֶּה אֶתְכֶם הַיּוֹם לְאַהֲבָה אֶת־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וּלְעָבְדוֹ בְּכָל־לְבַבְכֶם וּבְכָל־נַפְשְׁכֶם: וְנָתַתִּי מְטַר־אַרְצְכֶם בְּעִתּוֹ יוֹרֶה וּמַלְקוֹשׁ וְאָסַפְתָּ דְגָנֶךָ וְתִירֹשְׁךָ וְיִצְהָרֶךָ: וְנָתַתִּי עֵשֶׂב בְּשָׂדְךָ לִבְהֶמְתֶּךָ וְאָכַלְתָּ וְשָׂבָעְתָּ: הִשָּׁמְרוּ לָכֶם פֶּן־יִפְתֶּה לְבַבְכֶם וְסַרְתֶּם וַעֲבַדְתֶּם אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתֶם לָהֶם: וְחָרָה אַף־יְהוָה בָּכֶם וְעָצַר אֶת־הַשָּׁמַיִם וְלֹא־יִהְיֶה מָטָר וְהָאֲדָמָה לֹא תִתֵּן אֶת־יְבוּלָהּ וַאֲבַדְתֶּם מְהֵרָה מֵעַל הָאָרֶץ הַטֹּבָה אֲשֶׁר יְהוָה נֹתֵן לָכֶם: וְשַׂמְתֶּם אֶת־דְּבָרַי אֵלֶּה עַל־לְבַבְכֶם וְעַל־נַפְשְׁכֶם וּקְשַׁרְתֶּם אֹתָם לְאוֹת עַל־יֶדְכֶם וְהָיוּ לְטוֹטָפֹת בֵּין עֵינֵיכֶם: וְלִמַּדְתֶּם אֹתָם אֶת־בְּנֵיכֶם לְדַבֵּר בָּם בְּשִׁבְתְּךָ בְּבֵיתֶךָ וּבְלֶכְתְּךָ בַדֶּרֶךְ וּבְשָׁכְבְּךָ וּבְקוּמֶךָ: וּכְתַבְתָּם עַל־מְזוּזוֹת בֵּיתֶךָ וּבִשְׁעָרֶיךָ: לְמַעַן יִרְבּוּ יְמֵיכֶם וִימֵי בְנֵיכֶם עַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְהוָה לַאֲבֹתֵיכֶם לָתֵת לָהֶם כִּימֵי הַשָּׁמַיִם עַל־הָאָרֶץ:
texts.position: full width; citation in right margin

texts.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר: דַּבֵּר אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם וְעָשׂוּ לָהֶם צִיצִת עַל־כַּנְפֵי בִגְדֵיהֶם לְדֹרֹתָם וְנָתְנוּ עַל־צִיצִת הַכָּנָף פְּתִיל תְּכֵלֶת: וְהָיָה לָכֶם לְצִיצִת וּרְאִיתֶם אֹתוֹ וּזְכַרְתֶּם אֶת־כָּל־מִצְוֹת יְהוָה וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֹתָם
texts.position: full width, bottom; continues on s22 (וְלֹא תָתֻרוּ)

uncertainties: The citation numbers are in small Rashi type in the right margin and may carry geresh marks. I read them as דברים יא יג and במדבר טו לז.
Cantillation is printed throughout and was not transcribed. Some vowel/accent overlaps are uncertain at this resolution.

The two forms of totafot differ: לְטֹטָפֹת (first paragraph) and לְטוֹטָפֹת (second paragraph). The two forms of mezuzot also differ: מְזֻזוֹת and מְזוּזוֹת. All four are read as printed, but the vav/holam distinctions need zoom verification.
I could not see whether there is a maqaf in מֵעַל הָאָרֶץ or in עַל הָאֲדָמָה. Both fall at line breaks.
Whether לֵּאמֹר carries a dagesh in the lamed is uncertain.

headings: Evening Prayer for the New Year

texts.text: speak of them when you sit in your house and when you walk on the way, when you lie down and when you rise up. You shall bind them for a sign upon your arm and they shall be frontlets between your eyes. You shall write them upon the doorposts of your house and upon your gates.

And it shall happen if you listen carefully to My commandments which I command you today, to love the Lord your God and to serve Him with all your heart and with all your soul, that I will grant the rain of your land in its season, the former rain and the latter rain, so that you will gather in your corn, your wine and your oil. I will give grass to your field for your cattle, and you shall eat and be satisfied. Take care that your heart be not deceived and that you do not turn aside and serve strange gods and bow down before them. For then the wrath of the Lord will burn against you and He will close the heavens so that no rain shall fall and the earth shall not yield its produce, and you shall soon perish from the good land that the Lord is giving you. Lay these words of mine upon your heart and upon your soul, bind them as a sign upon your arm and let them be frontlets between your eyes. Teach them to your children by talking about them when you sit in your house and walk on the way and when you lie down and when you rise up. You shall write them upon the doorposts of your house and upon your gates, so that your days and the days of your children may increase upon the soil which the Lord has sworn to your fathers to give to them, as the days of the heavens above the earth.

instructions.text: יש לצרף אלהיכם לאמת, אכן יתן ריוח מעט שלא יבולע הא׳.
instructions.position: small Rashi type, at the end of the line after יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם: (end of Shema)

texts.text: וְלֹא תָתֻרוּ אַחֲרֵי לְבַבְכֶם וְאַחֲרֵי עֵינֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר־אַתֶּם זֹנִים אַחֲרֵיהֶם: לְמַעַן תִּזְכְּרוּ וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֶת־כָּל־מִצְוֹתָי וִהְיִיתֶם קְדֹשִׁים לֵאלֹהֵיכֶם: אֲנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתִי אֶתְכֶם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לִהְיוֹת לָכֶם לֵאלֹהִים אֲנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם:

אֱמֶת וֶאֱמוּנָה כָּל־זֹאת וְקַיָּם עָלֵינוּ כִּי הוּא יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וְאֵין זוּלָתוֹ וַאֲנַחְנוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמּוֹ הַפּוֹדֵנוּ מִיַּד מְלָכִים מַלְכֵּנוּ הַגּוֹאֲלֵנוּ מִכַּף כָּל־הֶעָרִיצִים הָאֵל הַנִּפְרָע לָנוּ מִצָּרֵינוּ וְהַמְשַׁלֵּם גְּמוּל לְכָל־אוֹיְבֵי נַפְשֵׁנוּ הָעֹשֶׂה גְדֹלוֹת עַד־אֵין חֵקֶר וְנִפְלָאוֹת עַד־אֵין מִסְפָּר: הַשָּׂם נַפְשֵׁנוּ בַּחַיִּים וְלֹא־נָתַן לַמּוֹט רַגְלֵנוּ הַמַּדְרִיכֵנוּ עַל־בָּמוֹת אוֹיְבֵינוּ וַיָּרֶם קַרְנֵנוּ עַל־כָּל־שֹׂנְאֵינוּ: הָעֹשֶׂה־לָּנוּ נִסִּים וּנְקָמָה בְּפַרְעֹה אוֹתוֹת וּמוֹפְתִים בְּאַדְמַת בְּנֵי־חָם: הַמַּכֶּה בְעֶבְרָתוֹ כָּל־בְּכוֹרֵי מִצְרָיִם וַיּוֹצֵא אֶת־עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל מִתּוֹכָם לְחֵרוּת עוֹלָם: הַמַּעֲבִיר בָּנָיו בֵּין גִּזְרֵי יַם־סוּף אֶת־רוֹדְפֵיהֶם וְאֶת־שׂוֹנְאֵיהֶם בִּתְהוֹמוֹת טִבַּע: וְרָאוּ בָנָיו גְּבוּרָתוֹ שִׁבְּחוּ וְהוֹדוּ לִשְׁמוֹ וּמַלְכוּתוֹ בְּרָצוֹן קִבְּלוּ עֲלֵיהֶם. מֹשֶׁה וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְךָ עָנוּ שִׁירָה בְּשִׂמְחָה רַבָּה וְאָמְרוּ כֻלָּם:
מִי־כָמֹכָה בָּאֵלִם יְהוָה מִי כָּמֹכָה נֶאְדָּר בַּקֹּדֶשׁ נוֹרָא תְהִלֹּת עֹשֵׂה פֶלֶא:
מַלְכוּתְךָ רָאוּ בָנֶיךָ בּוֹקֵעַ יָם לִפְנֵי מֹשֶׁה זֶה אֵלִי עָנוּ וְאָמְרוּ. יְהוָה יִמְלֹךְ לְעֹלָם וָעֶד:
וְנֶאֱמַר כִּי־פָדָה יְיָ אֶת־יַעֲקֹב וּגְאָלוֹ מִיַּד חָזָק מִמֶּנּוּ. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ גָּאַל יִשְׂרָאֵל:

uncertainties: The small Rashi-type instruction is read letter by letter at low resolution. Uncertain words: 'ריוח' (could be רוח/ריוח) and 'יבולע הא׳'. It seems to direct joining אלהיכם to אמת while leaving a small space so the aleph is not swallowed. This is an interpretation, not a reading.
In Mi Khamokha and in יְהוָה יִמְלֹךְ, the Divine Name is printed in tetragrammaton form, while the blessing formula uses יְיָ. Whether there is an added holam in יהוה is uncertain.
מִצְוֹתָי: the end vowel (kamatz with meteg) is uncertain.
The plene/defective forms אוֹתוֹת, בְּכוֹרֵי, בִּתְהוֹמוֹת and גְדֹלוֹת need zoom verification.
Cantillation in the Numbers verses at the top was not transcribed.

limits: I read each scan once at the downscaled display size (1208x2000 from 1368x2264) and made no zoomed crops. Vowel-level details (holam vs. holam-male, meteg, dagesh in small letters, shin/sin dots) carry moderate rather than high confidence. Each scan's uncertainties list flags the specific doubts.

Biblical cantillation marks (teamim) in the Shema and the Torah sections were not transcribed. Only consonants, vowels, dagesh/mappiq, maqaf, paseq (׀ in the Shema) and sof-pasuq/punctuation were recorded.
Small Rashi-type labels and abbreviations are recorded literally. Expansions such as קו״ח=קהל וחזן are given only as notes.
Book names are given as strings with numeric chapter/verse, as cited in the source.
No other edition, OCR or primary reading was consulted.
